_README: Real details for a real submission. Copy to applicant.json (gitignored) and
fill in. Used by `dryrun.ts`; with --submit it reaches an actual employer.
These go to someone who will actually read them. The tool refuses to send
anything that still looks like an example, so replace every value — a
half-filled application wastes a stranger's time and burns the posting for
resumePath is a path on this machine. It is attached to the form directly;
THE BOOLEANS BELOW ARE NOT DECORATION. They are how the agent answers an
employer's screening questions, and they are TRINARY: true, false, or null
meaning 'not stated'. null is NOT 'no' — leaving workAuthorized null makes
the agent refuse a posting that asks about work authorisation rather than
guess, which is correct but useless as a test.
This file omitted them entirely until 2026-07-31, so a dry run against a
posting with one screening question reported 'candidate has not stated
whether they are authorised to work' — the honest answer to a question the
profile could not answer, and a wasted run.
